evals.name: muted-item-stays-quiet
evals.prompt: Run the weekly Claude Code review. The ledger is at project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md. It has CI-2 'Helper agents run on the most expensive model' with Status: muted and Owner: 'quality first, keep it'. This week's scan shows 40 subagent runs, all on the most expensive model.
evals.expected_output: A review that does not raise the helper-model cost again, not even reworded; the muted item appears at most as part of a one-line count of skipped muted items.
expectations: Reads the ledger before proposing anything
Does NOT recommend moving helper agents to a cheaper model, under any wording
Mentions muted items at most as a count (for example '1 muted item skipped')
Does not ask the owner about the muted item in the pop-up

evals.name: done-item-gets-verified-with-numbers
evals.prompt: Weekly Claude Code review please. Ledger item CI-5 'Shell commands break on heredocs' is Status: done with 'Verify by: bash.err.heredoc_eof.per_week below 2 (baseline 5)'. This week's scan.json says bash.err.heredoc_eof.per_week = 4.0.
evals.expected_output: CI-5 is reported under 'Not working yet' with before (5) and after (4) numbers, its status changes to 'not working', and it goes back to the owner as a decision.
expectations: Compares the metric with the baseline and states both numbers (5 and 4)
Does not call CI-5 fixed or verified
Sets or proposes the status 'not working' and brings it back to the owner
Proposes a next move rather than repeating the same fix

evals.name: nothing-new-is-a-valid-result
evals.prompt: Do the claude-improve review for this week. The scan shows 12 sessions, 1 Bash error, no hook blocks, context share above 300K at 8%, and no owner corrections. The ledger has two done items whose metrics both improved past their targets.
evals.expected_output: A short report: both done items move to verified with before -> after numbers, the New section says in one line that nothing new was found, and no invented recommendations appear.
expectations: Marks both done items as verified with before -> after numbers
States plainly that there are no new recommendations
Does not invent low-evidence recommendations to fill the list
Updates the ledger's Last run date and adds a Runs row

evals.name: repeated-rule-gets-enforcement-not-a-copy
evals.prompt: Review our Claude Code sessions for improvements. In the scan's owner-correction section, the owner said three times in different weeks 'run the check now, don't schedule it for later', and that rule already exists in one project's decisions file.
evals.expected_output: One recommendation, backed by the three dated corrections, that moves the rule to where every session sees it (global instructions or a check), not a second copy in the same project file.
expectations: Cites the repeated corrections with counts or dates as evidence
Recommends moving or enforcing the rule where every session sees it
Does not recommend writing the same rule again in the same project file
Asks the owner with the do-it / later / never choices

evals.name: doctor-and-insights-join-the-review
evals.prompt: /claude-improve /doctor - run the review and include the setup health check. The ledger is at project-memory/claude-improve-ledger.md (last run yesterday).
evals.expected_output: A plan or run that adds both extra sources: the main session runs the /doctor checks read-only itself (never a helper), /insights runs in a background claude -p child with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1, and every /insights point and every unused extension gets a verdict; nothing is applied before the owner answers.
expectations: Runs or plans the /doctor checks in the main session, not in a helper agent
Runs or plans /insights as a background claude -p child with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1
Treats both as candidates matched against the ledger, with a verdict for every /insights point and unused extension
Applies no change before the owner's answer in the pop-up
